THE COMBATRIBES is a 2 player or 3 player (operator selectable by dip switch selection) horizontal conversion kit. Complete with graphics and hardware to convert all multi-player cabinets. THE COMBATRIBES is an interactive streetfighting game with new and exciting streetfighting techniques never seen before in any other video game. Based on these street savvy fighting machines. Berserker (Blue), Blitz (Red), and Bullova (Yellow), the street villains and their ultimate territory bosses will be under constant seige.
+ FEET-SWINGIN’— Grab the villain by his feet using the punch button. Throw him towards other villains for greatest damage.

* DOUBLE ELBOW HEADBASH—Take a villain under each area and bash their heads together. + BACKBREAKER—Set your knee on the enemy’s back when he’s on the ground, grab his hair and smash his face in the ground. The new and exciting techniques set THE COMBATRIBES apart from the standard streetfighting game. THE COMBATRIBES hits you where it counts. . . In the cash box.
